articles.summary: One storm. Thousands of calls. A network of connected computer aided dispatch (CAD) systems. A major holiday weekend went from routine to chaotic when an unexpected storm swept through southern Michigan the evening of July 3, driving emergency call volumes into the thousands across Lenawee and Jackson counties. Call volumes in Lenawee County surged from an average of just 5.5 calls an hour to 1,509 calls in a single hour, more than 270 times the county's typical hourly volume that day....
